title: Voyage autour de ma chambre
summary: "Voyage autour de ma chambre" by Xavier de Maistre is a book written in 1794. Confined to his room for 42 days as punishment for fighting an illegal duel, de Maistre transforms his sentence into a whimsical travelogue. Written in the style of an 18th-century travel narrative, he chronicles his "journey" around his furniture and possessions, discovering wonder in everyday surroundings. Through imaginary dialogues, reflections on his absent love, and meditations on paintings, de Maistre argues that true pleasure depends not on exotic destinations but on one's own mindset.
